result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I ran the scoping tests (`-Dtest='*Scoping*'`) and they pass, but I didn't add tests for the new cases.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the extension group in the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules was `(html|html|xhtml)`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages land in the generated scope. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **Generated code:** the path pattern for `<doc>` XML files was `.*/[.]xml` and the one for `// Generated by …` JavaScript was `.*/[.]js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match.
- **Gradle scripts:** the build-and-deployment pattern was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. The separate `.*[.]gradle` rule for `build.gradle` is unchanged.

The content patterns weren't touched, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes. The `<doc>` content pattern still matches only a line that is exactly `<doc>`.
